idea-plugin.name: CommitWise
idea-plugin.description:
CommitWise reads the staged Git diff and writes a well-formed commit message with your own LLM, then reviews the change and marks issues on exact lines. Keys stay in the system credential store; nothing is ever committed automatically.

Highlights
  • Generate Conventional Commits / Angular / Gitmoji / plain-text messages; the draft in the commit input box is backed up before writing and can be restored.
  • Review staged code across five dimensions (defect / security / performance / maintainability / test); issues are anchored to exact added lines with file-level fallback.
  • Editor squiggles plus Alt+Enter Quick Fix to apply a model suggestion (replace / insert below / cancel) with undo support.
  • OpenAI-compatible (DeepSeek / Qwen / Moonshot / GLM / self-hosted gateway), Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, and local Ollama adapters. Keys are stored in the IDE PasswordSafe, never in config files.
  • Secret-like values are redacted before sending; glob exclusion rules and per-file/total char budgets keep context size under control.
  • Commit message history (last 10, ring buffer), review report exportable to Markdown, status bar showing model and last review issue count.

The plugin is commit-dialog aware: it reads the checkbox-selected files in IDEA's Commit dialog (not only git diff --cached), so it works the way you actually commit in IDEA.

Docs, screenshots and configuration examples: commitwise.aikio.blog
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.0
Initial release on JetBrains Marketplace.
  • Generate Conventional Commits / Angular / Gitmoji / plain-text messages from staged diff or Commit-dialog selected files
  • Five-dimension code review with line-level anchoring and Alt+Enter Quick Fix
  • OpenAI-compatible / Anthropic / Azure OpenAI / Ollama adapters, keys in PasswordSafe
  • Context budget control, glob exclusion, secret redaction
  • Commit message history, review report Markdown export, status bar widget
  • Pre-flight config check: missing model or key triggers guided setup instead of runtime error
  • 206 unit tests covering diff parsing, redaction, templates, review parsing, SSE streaming, git collection, config validation
